subject: general
question: In which of the following years did the Twelfth Five Year Plan end?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__2017__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **12th Five-Year Plan** of the Government of India **(2012–17) **served as the last Five-Year Plan for the nation.
 
• Its main theme was “Faster, More Inclusive and Sustainable Growth”
 
• The **Twelfth Five-Year Plan** of the Government of India was **expected to achieve a growth rate of 9%,** however, on **December 27, 2012, the National Development Council approved an 8% growth rate instead.**
 
• In the 12th Five-Year Plan, the government wants to see a **10% decrease in poverty.**
 
• The strategy aims to **enhance national infrastructure initiatives **while avoiding bottlenecks of any form.
 
• In the 12th five-year plan, the planning commission's report seeks to increase private infrastructure investment by up to $1 trillion and lower the government's subsidy **burden from 2% of GDP to 1.5% of GDP.**
 
• The plan's subsidies will be transferred in **cash via the Unique Identification Number.**
